vitrine.titre: Find the tenders that match you, before their deadline.
vitrine.texte: Tenders and job openings from donors, the United Nations, NGOs and public procurement, for the companies, consultants and candidates who respond to them.
vitrine.urgentesTexte: {n} opportunities close this week. Here are those closest to their deadline.
vitrine.aucuneUrgente: No opportunity closes in the next 7 days.
vitrine.faqTexte: What to know before you start.
vitrine.r1: A watch on tenders and job openings published by {sources} sources: donors, United Nations agencies, NGOs and national public procurement portals. {total} opportunities collected to date, sorted by sector, country and deadline.
vitrine.r2: Those closing in the next 7 days, from nearest to furthest. The map shows all open opportunities by place.
vitrine.q3: How do I access the official notices?
vitrine.r3: Create an account: for 14 days, you can open as many official notices as you like, with the full list and its filters, suggestions based on your profile and email alerts. After that, a subscription gives you credits.
vitrine.c1Texte: Unlimited official notices as soon as you sign up.
vitrine.c2Texte: After the trial, it is counted when you click "View the official notice".
vitrine.c3Texte: The same opportunity, reopened the same day, only counts once.
vitrine.creditsTexte: Searching, filtering and reading pages is free. Credits are used to open official notices.
vitrine.plusCreditsTexte: No online payment: the subscription is activated as soon as your payment is received.
vitrine.appel: Sign in to see the {n} available opportunities, with their official notices.
